{{Top|leg}}
A '''Waiver Violation Form''' was an internal [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] document. [[Starship/Legends|Starships]] violating the [[Waivers List]] were detailed with a Form, which was then transmitted to every Authority vessel within a couple of [[Standard day/Legends|days]].
